typography.instructions: Do NOT use Inter or Roboto. Apply tracking-tighter on headings larger than 32px. Use Outfit for all headings, IBM Plex Sans for body text. Use varying font weights (e.g., font-light, font-medium) to create tension.

colors.instructions: Follow 'Old Money Tech' & 'Luxury' archetypes: use deep midnight blues/teals as the base with high-contrast vibrant orange (#F97316) for primary CTAs and electric teal (#00D4FF) for subtle highlights. Maintain a minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio. Ensure text is accessible over gradients/images. Never use pure #000000.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use Glassmorphism (Crystal/Apple variant) for Sticky Headers (backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 with 1px border-white/10). Use Grid Borders (technical look) for data-heavy sections and footers. Add subtle noise/grain texture to hero backgrounds.
visual_enhancers.gradients: Do NOT use full-screen gradients. Use subtle radial glows (blur-3xl) behind key elements to create depth.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Use ambient and direct shadows. E.g., shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.12)] for cards on hover.

components.navigation: Sticky mega-menu with glassmorphism surface. Include Logo, Products, Solutions, Industries, Resources, Company. Right side: Contact CTA button. Must have z-50 and not overlap content.
components.buttons: Pill-shaped or slightly rounded (rounded-md). Primary CTAs should use the vibrant orange with hover lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow-lg. Always define focus states (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary).
components.cards: Flat background (card color), 1px subtle border, no initial shadow. On hover: slight lift, border color lightens, subtle shadow.
components.forms: Use Shadcn Form, Input, Select, Textarea. Deep background for inputs with 1px solid border. Active/Focus state gets primary ring.
components.chatbot: Floating AI widget (concierge) at bottom-right. Circular button. Clicking opens a modern chat window with chat history (Shadcn scroll-area).
components.icons: Use lucide-react. Ensure all icons have stroke-width of 1.5 or 2 based on visual weight.

layouts.hero: Asymmetric bento grid or large split layout. Max overlay opacity bg-black/50 for background images. Massive H1.
layouts.stats_band: High-density grid (grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4). Massive typography for numbers (text-5xl+) with tiny overline labels.
layouts.solutions_grid: Bento Grid Protocol (Tetris Grid). Asymmetric card spans (col-span-full md:col-span-8, col-span-4, etc.) to create visual tension.
layouts.industries: Cardless or flat-rectangular cards with sharp edges. Use hover-reveals for more info.
layouts.footer: Massive space (py-24). Include newsletter signup, sitemap links. Dark background. Very large brand logo/text at bottom.

motion.instructions: All interactive elements MUST have hover and active state transitions. Use Framer Motion for staggered list entrances, scroll-triggered reveals, and micro-interactions on cards. Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Do NOT use 'transition: all', specify properties (e.g., transition-colors, transition-transform).
motion.marquee: Use a subtle editorial ribbon or kinetic marquee for customer logos. Very slow, smooth drift.

accessibility.instructions: Ensure all form inputs have labels. Use ARIA attributes. Interactive elements must have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='contact-submit-button'). Ensure 4.5:1 text contrast. Add focus indicators.

hero_backgrounds.description: Blue background with lines and dots (Abstract Data Network) - Use for Hero section background
Blue abstract background with lines and dots - Use for Data Lake or Platform section

data_center.description: Modern data center rows - Use for Solutions or About/Company page
Close-up of modern server unit - Use for Products list/detail page

images.instructions: Use lucide-react icons for additional client logos in the marquee if needed. Use these images with careful overlays (e.g. bg-black/50) so text is always readable.

universal_guidelines.instructions: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy. Avoid generic centered layouts and simplistic gradients. Every interaction needs micro-animations. Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Do NOT apply universal 'transition: all'. Prioritize optical alignment. Do not center-align the main App container.

instructions_to_main_agent.1: Initialize React + FastAPI + MongoDB project structure. Setup Tailwind CSS with provided custom colors.
instructions_to_main_agent.2: Create multi-page routing (Home, Products, Solutions, Industries, Resources, Company, Careers, Partners, Contact).
instructions_to_main_agent.4: Build Home page with bento-grid layouts, animated hero, stats band, and marquee.
instructions_to_main_agent.5: Implement functional AI chatbot (site concierge) widget pinned to bottom right. Include chat history.
instructions_to_main_agent.6: Build Contact / Demo page with form submission connected to FastAPI backend, saved to MongoDB.
instructions_to_main_agent.7: Use Shadcn components for forms, scroll-areas, dialogs, cards, but heavily customize them to match the Luxury/Tech dark theme.
instructions_to_main_agent.8: Include data-testid attributes on all interactive elements.
